title: コンクリート・ジャンキーと、嘘つきな桜
author: 鉄屑 カノン

en.title: Concrete Junkie and the Lying Cherry Blossoms
en.premise: A scavenger scouring the ruins just to survive, I stumble upon a map leading to the 'Underground Library' hidden in the city's deepest depths. Rumor has it that 'real plants'—the kind that once painted the world in color—are preserved there. With my filtration filters failing and my canned rations running dry, I descend the rusted stairs, driven by nothing more than curiosity and a flicker of hope.

zh.title: 混凝土瘾君子与谎言之樱
zh.premise: 为了生存而搜寻废弃物的我，偶然获得了一张通往城市最深处“地下图书馆”的地图。传闻那里保存着曾经为世界染上色彩的“真正的植物”。在过滤滤芯即将失效、罐头储备也见底的绝望境地中，我怀着单纯的好奇心与一丝期待，走下了那座生锈的阶梯。
